policy_probe.provenance: Cumulative agent-authored development probes. The latest six wording variants were discovered and fixed in-sample; the total is not blind, independent or representative. Text-only: no attached pixels or attachment metadata processed.

image_routing_dataset.provenance: Agent-authored Vietnamese/English policy development probes. The 2026-10-29 extension from 30 to 36 followed direct policy inspection that found patient-in-clinic, patient-seen, semicolon-linked image, case-from-clinic, person-treated, and person-under-care misses. Query wording informed policy changes on this same dataset; fully in-sample and not independent, blind, clinically adjudicated, or representative. The 2026-10-29 extension from 36 to 41 follows a second policy-boundary review for cross-sentence image references, implicit clinical image ownership, hospital/service patient context, and caregiver wording. These five additions are agent-authored, fully in-sample development probes, not independent or clinically adjudicated. A further 2026-10-29 wording audit extended the development set from 41 to 46 after finding five misses involving Vietnamese patient-image ownership, child film wording, past treatment/consultation wording, and image acquisition followed by a separate sentence. This extension is in-sample and agent-authored, not independent or clinically adjudicated. The v7 extension from 46 to 51 adds five agent-authored personal-image wording probes, remains fully in-sample, and has no independent or specialist adjudication.
